name: Andrzej Halicki - § 14 - Am 13
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 14. Criticises the cuts to EMFAF allocations in the 2025 budget; stresses the strategic role of fisheries and aquaculture and the need for them to receive adequate financial support; calls for the 2026 budget to compensate for the cuts made in 2025 and to increase the allocations in the EMFAF to enable the fisheries sector to address, in an ambitious and practical way, the increase in production costs faced by fisheries, in particular small-scale, artisanal and coastal fisheries; believes that the EMFAF should help ensure a stable income and long-term future for fishers, help establish compensation and support mechanisms for fishers in the light of the instability of the profession, help support an integrated maritime policy, while protecting the outermost regions’ role and particular characteristics and contributing to the protection of sustainable marine ecosystems; insists that special attention must be given to the EU’s fishing fleet in order to improve safety and security, including by combating illegal fishery actions and improving working conditions, energy efficiency and sustainability, as well as to renew the fleet;reaffirms that the European Maritime Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund (EMFAF) shouldsupport a human resources policy capable of addressing future challenges, in order to promote an inclusive, diversified and sustainable blue economy;expresses its concern about the effect of the end of the Brexit transition period in June 2026 on the fishing and aquaculture sectors;
